product.name: MyAlice Conversational AI Platform
product.description: A SaaS platform that automates sales, support, and customer engagement across messaging channels like WhatsApp, Instagram, and others for eCommerce and DTC brands.

product.name: MyAlice Shared WhatsApp Inbox
product.description: A shared inbox solution that consolidates WhatsApp and other messaging channels into one dashboard for team collaboration and customer communication management.

product.name: MyAlice Chatbot Builder
product.description: A chatbot creation tool for automating customer support and sales interactions across all integrated messaging channels.

product.name: MyAlice eCommerce Integrations
product.description: Integrations with eCommerce platforms like Shopify and WooCommerce to synchronize order data and enable chat-based order management.

product.name: MyAlice Sales and Marketing Automation
product.description: Automation tools for WhatsApp marketing campaigns, customer profiling, order notifications, and sales reporting.
